name: Brazilian flex-fuel vehicle market
description: Brazilian motorists gained access to vehicles accepting ethanol and gasoline blends.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: A Brazilian government report dates commercial launch of flex-fuel vehicles to March 2003.

evidence.supports: Brazilian report gives a March 2003 flex-fuel launch and 48,200 flex-vehicle sales in 2003, attributing industrial statistics to ANFAVEA; sales cover the market, not a single model.

events.caveats: Market launch does not establish affordability to all households.
